name: MC_MEMBER_TASKS
description: This table contains information about health plan member tasks.

columns.name: TASK_ID
columns.description: The unique identifier (.1 item) for the task record.

columns.name: TASK_CONTEXT_C_NAME
columns.description: The task context category ID for the task.

columns.name: TASK_TYPE_C_NAME
columns.description: The task type category ID for the task.

columns.name: SOURCE_TEMPLATE_RECORD_ID
columns.description: The unique ID of the task template record (LTT) associated with this task.

columns.name: SOURCE_TEMPLATE_RECORD_ID_RECORD_NAME
columns.description: This column displays the name of the task template record.

columns.name: SOURCE_TASK_ID
columns.description: The unique ID of the source task record (LTR) associated with this task.

columns.name: SOURCE_TASK_ID_TASK_NAME
columns.description: The name of the task record.

columns.name: START_INSTANT_LOCAL_DTTM
columns.description: The start instant for a task in local format.

columns.name: END_DATE
columns.description: The date when the task is marked as completed.
